column3: “Cunning magician” gives a magical sense to the skilled worker.
“His glorious presence” renders “the eyes of His glory.”
“Enjoy” renders eating the fruit of their deeds.
“Turn you from your paths” replaces the image of swallowing the way of their paths.
“Foreheads” gives one sense of the expression for their exposed parts.
“Shame” stands for a brand mark; the girding with sackcloth is shortened to “sackcloth.”
